class.name: BulletRotationData2D
class.description: One bullet's spin: how fast the texture turns, how fast it is allowed to get, and how quickly it accelerates. Put one entry per bullet in [MultiMeshBulletsData2D.all_bullet_rotation_data] — entry [code]i[/code] rotates bullet [code]i[/code] only. Use [method generate_random_data] to roll a batch with ranges. A null entry or NaN/Inf values read as zero spin for that bullet only.

method.name: generate_random_data
method.description: Generates random rotation data: amount_to_generate entries with each value rolled inside its MIN/MAX range. Requires amount_to_generate above 0 and every MIN at or below its MAX, otherwise returns empty.

members.member: The maximum rotation speed that the bullets can have.
The amount by which the rotation speeds up every frame until reaching max_rotation_speed.
